about: GTA 6 Trailer vs Reality: the store holdup (Delta, slug gta-holdup). Rockstar's GTA VI Trailer 1 (December 4, 2023, rockstargames.com/VI/an-extended-look lists the date) ends on a masked pair with a red bandana bursting into a convenience store, guns up (Trailer 1, 76.5-78.4 s, then the VI logo). Rockstar's 'An Extended Look' (August 27, 2026, 'Captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5') shows store holdups again (705-733 s): a low camera on a red-bandana robber and a masked partner in store aisles, and a third-person store shot with a HUD (wanted stars, ammo 20 / 73, pistol icon) at 706-711 s. Sources in BRIEF.md.
